step1_dimension_formula.method: Riemann-Roch dimension formula for weight-k forms on the orbifold H/Gamma, independently derived by this implementer via Euler-characteristic bookkeeping BEFORE consulting KMSV, then cross-checked against KMSV eq (5.4) after reading it (papers/kmsv-1311.2081-numerical-belyi-maps.pdf p.34) -- FORMULAS MATCH EXACTLY: dim S_k(Gamma) = (k-1)(g-1) + sum_i floor(k(e_i-1)/(2 e_i)), k even >= 4, with dim S_2 = g.
step1_dimension_formula.orbifold_signature_derived: H/Gamma has genus g'=0 with 3 cone points of orders (7,7,2) -- derived from the LMFDB monodromy cycle types (lam1=7.1.1 gives 2 fixed points => 2 cone points of order 7; lam2=2.2.2.2.1 gives 1 fixed point => 1 cone point of order 2; lam3=3.3.3 gives 0 fixed points => 0 cone points from that branch), cross-checked via orbifold Euler characteristic additivity (chi_orb(H/Gamma) = 9 * chi_orb(H/Delta) = 9*(-1/42) = -3/14, consistent with g'=0 and the (7,7,2) cone-point signature by direct computation)
step1_dimension_formula.result: dim S_2(Gamma)=0 (matches g=0, sanity check), dim S_4=1, dim S_6=1, dim S_8=2 -- k=8 is the MINIMAL even weight with dim>=2, needed to form the hauptmodul ratio x=f1/f2 per spec sec3.3 / KMSV sec5
step1_dimension_formula.verified_by: hand computation cross-checked against KMSV's own formula (5.4), both independently derived and confirmed to agree; not yet independently machine-executed as a standalone script this ben (arithmetic is simple enough to be low-risk, but flagged: this specific dimension computation was NOT run through a separate GAP/Python producer-checker pair this ben, unlike other results in this campaign)

step2_L6_hypergeometric_delta_side_MAJOR.source_read_this_ben: papers/kmsv-1311.2081-numerical-belyi-maps.pdf, pp.33-36 (Section 4, 'Hypergeometric series' subsection, eq 4.9-4.16), read via the Read tool's PDF-page-image mode (pdftotext OCR was garbled for the formula-heavy passage; the image render resolved this unambiguously)
step2_L6_hypergeometric_delta_side_MAJOR.CORRECTION_TO_SPEC: pilot_port_scheme_v1.md sec1.3/sec3.3 (mathematician's own general-knowledge reconstruction, self-flagged as unread-KMSV) stated the expansion point p should be 'a GENERIC point avoiding elliptic points/cusps'. Having now read KMSV directly: this is WRONG for the actual method -- KMSV expands phi (the Delta-hauptmodul) AT the elliptic point p=z_a itself (a NON-generic point), exploiting the local rotation-by-zeta_a automorphy there to get a clean lacunary series (only powers of w^a appear). Per spec's own instruction ('KMSVが勝つ'), this correction is adopted; spec's L5/L6 table description is superseded by this. Flagged for the mathematician's record.
step2_L6_hypergeometric_delta_side_MAJOR.delta_side_formula: phi(w) = (w/kappa)^a + [a(C(1+A-C)(1+B-C)-AB(2-C))/(C(2-C))] (w/kappa)^{2a} + ... in Q[[(w/kappa)^a]], obtained as the reversion of psi(t)=kappa*F1(t)/F2(t) where F1,F2 are a basis of solutions to the 2F1 hypergeometric ODE with parameters A,B,C given by (4.10).
step2_L6_hypergeometric_delta_side_MAJOR.our_ab c_labeling: a=3 (our delta_inf, order3, fixes z_a=i), b=7 (our delta_0, on-axis z_b), c=2 (our delta_1, off-axis z_c) -- matches ben2's engine-convention (a_eng,b_eng,c_eng)=(3,7,2) exactly, so this L6 computation is at the SAME expansion point already used for the (now-superseded-by-this-finding) L3/L4 kite construction.

step3_L5_gamma_side_GENUINE_BLOCKER.finding: KMSV's actual method for the S_8(Gamma) (weight-8 cusp/automorphic form) basis on the Gamma side is NOT the naive Hejhal-style multi-sample-point linear system this implementer had initially assumed and begun designing in ben2 (which additionally would have depended on the not-fully-hardened L4 FD reduction). Re-reading KMSV sec5 ('Genus zero' paragraph, p.35) shows the actual method computes 'an echelonized basis [28, sec4.4] of functions with respect to the coefficients b_n' -- i.e. it defers to a SEPARATE, EXTERNALLY-REFERENCED algorithm (citation [28] in KMSV's bibliography) for constructing the S_k(Gamma) power-series basis via echelon-form coefficient manipulation, which is NOT reproduced within KMSV itself and was not identified/read this ben.
step3_L5_gamma_side_GENUINE_BLOCKER.why_this_is_a_genuine_stop_and_not_a_sho: Attempting to reconstruct this echelon-basis algorithm from general knowledge (as this implementer's ben2 Hejhal-style sketch had begun to do) carries real risk of silently encoding a WRONG automorphy/sampling convention that could produce numbers which superficially 'run' but are mathematically meaningless -- exactly the failure mode this workshop's CV-9/ORIENT discipline exists to prevent. Given the remaining ben3 time budget, this implementer chose NOT to force a fragile from-scratch reconstruction, and instead reports this as the honest, specific stuck point.
step3_L5_gamma_side_GENUINE_BLOCKER.what_would_be_needed_next: Either (a) identify and read KMSV's reference [28] (bibliography entry not yet looked up this ben) for the exact echelon-basis algorithm, or (b) get explicit mathematician/coordinator sign-off on a from-scratch Hejhal-numerical reconstruction of S_8(Gamma) using the existing (imperfect, see ben2 caveats) L4 FD-reduction machinery, accepting the associated risk flagged above.
